title: eventStore.latest: bounded reverse read of retained event metadata
answers: How do I read the most recent retained events at or below a resource version?
Where is the bounded event tail lookup implemented?
How to fetch latest N events up to a resource-version ceiling
body: eventStore.latest(ctx, limit, throughRV) in pkg/storage/unified/resource/eventstore.go returns up to `limit` events with ResourceVersion <= throughRV, newest-first. It builds ListOptions{Sort: SortOrderDesc, Limit: limit} and sets EndKey = strconv of throughRV+1 (key range end is exclusive) unless throughRV is math.MaxInt64. Keys are collected first, then read back in batches via readEventPage and reversed to restore ascending order in the result.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource/eventstore.go reads of the durable event tail
